title: 第0095章 长老震怒药力惊坛上第0094章 仙茅破障一拳轰飞林啸天
content_zh:
演武场上空的死寂，持续了整整三息。
那是一种近乎凝固的荒谬感——前一秒还不可一世、被寄予全族希望的林啸天，此刻像条死狗般瘫在台下十丈外的尘土里，胸口塌陷，鲜血染红了华丽的锦缎，生死不知。而那个曾被所有人视作“绝脉废柴”、连修炼资格都被剥夺的林药尘，却如一尊沉默的青石，伫立在擂台中央，周身气息虽不算磅礴，却带着一种斩断因果的凛冽。
“啸天！！！”
一声撕心裂肺的咆哮，终于打破了这片死寂。高台上，二长老林破天双目赤红，如同被激怒的凶兽，周身气息疯狂鼓荡，药徒九重的威压毫无保留地释放开来，震得整个演武场的地面都微微颤抖。他身形一晃，便要冲下高台。
“二弟，住手！”
大长老林苍穹的声音不高，却蕴含着一股不容置疑的威严，如同洪钟大吕，在林破天耳边炸响。一只枯瘦却蕴含着恐怖力道的手掌，凭空按在了林破天的肩头，将他硬生生定在原地。
“大哥你……”林破天猛地回头，眼中满是怨毒与不甘，但触及林苍穹那双深邃如古井的眼眸时，心头不由得一寒。
林苍穹面色阴沉如水，目光先是扫过重伤昏迷的林啸天，眉头紧锁，随即落在林药尘身上，那眼神复杂到了极点——惊疑、审视、一丝难以察觉的忌惮，还有一丝……连他自己都未曾察觉的松动。
“大比规则，点到为止，生死各安天命。难道你要当着全族子弟的面，违背祖训，对一个晚辈出手？”林苍穹的声音冷冽，敲打在每一个族人心上。
林破天胸口剧烈起伏，牙齿咬得咯咯作响，但最终，在林苍穹的绝对压制和家族规矩面前，他强行压下了滔天怒火，只是那眼神，几乎要将台下的林药尘生吞活剥。“好……好一个点到为止！林药尘，你废了我儿修为，此仇不共戴天！”
台下，林家族人们终于从巨大的震撼中回过神来，嗡嗡的议论声如同潮水般炸开。
“我的天……一拳！真的只是一拳！林药尘把林啸天打飞了！”
“这怎么可能？他不是绝脉之躯吗？怎么可能拥有药徒七重的力量？”
“你看他刚才那一拳的威势，赤金光芒，霸道无比，绝对不是《猛虎拳》的路子！”
“莫非……他真的恢复了？甚至……更强了？”
“更强？哼，不过是仗着诡异手段偷袭罢了！啸天少主是轻敌在先……”
“偷袭？你瞎了吗？刚才林啸天攻势多猛，是林药尘靠身法躲开的！那一拳的正面硬撼，威力如何，大家伙的眼睛又不瞎！”
震惊、疑惑、恐惧、幸灾乐祸……种种情绪在人群中交织。曾经对林药尘避之不及的旁系子弟们，此刻看向他的眼神充满了敬畏和陌生；而林破天一系的亲信们，则个个面色铁青，如同丧考妣。
高台上，几位长老面面相觑，气氛凝重。三长老捋着胡须，低声道：“大哥，药尘这孩子……藏得够深啊。绝脉复通，还能突破至药徒七重，方才那一拳的威力，恐怕已不逊于普通药徒八重。而且，他那拳力中蕴含的气息，颇为奇特。”
四长老也沉声附和：“确实奇特。非纯武道罡气，倒像是某种……药力高度凝聚后的爆发？难道他与传闻中的‘药修’有关联？”说到“药修”二字，几位长老的眼神都变得幽深起来。在这灵气枯竭的八荒世界，正统武道凋零，而能以草药炼体、借药力修行的“药修”之路，早已近乎失传，只存在于古老传说中。

林苍穹缓缓收回按在林破天肩头的手，目光始终没有离开林药尘。他自然也感受到了那一拳中蕴含的、不同于寻常武道真气的特殊波动。作为林家大长老，见识不凡，他隐约猜到，林药尘的蜕变，恐怕源于某种他们不了解的传承或机缘。
“此子，留不得，还是必须掌控在家族手中？”一个念头在林苍穹脑中飞速转动。林家如今看似强盛，实则内忧外患，北边有黑风寨的骚扰，南边与王家明争暗斗，内部各房系也是矛盾重重。一个拥有诡异恢复能力的“废柴”重新崛起，是福是祸？
这时，林药尘缓缓收回拳头，感受着体内依旧有些沸腾的仙茅药力，以及经脉中因突破而带来的微微胀痛。他抬头，迎向高台上林苍穹审视的目光，眼神平静，没有胜利者的得意，也没有对林破天的畏惧，只有一种历经磨难后的淡然与坚韧。
他躬身一礼，声音清晰沉稳：“大长老，弟子林药尘，已胜。依族规，当为大比头名。”
林苍穹沉默片刻，方才开口，声音听不出喜怒：“不错。大比头名，确当归你。”他顿了顿，目光扫视全场，威压降临，“今日之比试，结果既定。啸天伤势不轻，二弟，你即刻带他下去疗伤。其余众人，散去！”
“大哥！”林破天不甘地低吼。
“嗯？”林苍穹冷哼一声，眼皮一抬，一股更强的威压笼罩下来，“族规在上，你待如何？”
林破天身体一僵，最终从牙缝里挤出几个字：“……遵命。”他怨毒地剜了林药尘一眼，抱起昏迷的林啸天，在一众亲信的簇拥下，黑着脸快步离去。
随着人群的逐渐散去，演武场上只剩下满地的狼藉和高台上神色各异的长老们。林苍穹深深看了林药尘一眼，道：“药尘，你随我来祠堂。其余诸位，各自理事。”
说完，他拂袖而去。林药尘面色不变，默默跟上。他知道，真正的考验，现在才开始。一场关乎他未来命运，乃至林家内部权力格局的暗涌，即将在庄严肃穆的祠堂之中，正式拉开帷幕。
……
林家祠堂，位于家族腹地，古朴幽深，供奉着历代先祖的牌位。空气中弥漫着陈旧的木头味和淡淡的檀香气息。
林苍穹负手立于先祖牌位前，背影显得有些佝偻，却自有一股渊渟岳峙的气势。良久，他才缓缓开口，声音在空旷的祠堂里回荡：“你身上的毒，好了？绝脉，也通了？”
林药尘垂首：“回大长老，侥幸得奇遇，毒已解，经脉亦修复大半。”
“奇遇？”林苍穹转过身，目光锐利如刀，似要剖开林药尘的所有秘密，“何种奇遇，能化解‘腐骨散’，贯通天生绝脉？又能让你在短短时日内，修至药徒七重，并施展那等诡异拳法？”
林药尘心中早有准备，沉声道：“弟子不敢隐瞒。此前濒死之际，神魂恍惚，似坠入一片混沌药圃，得遇一缕残存意识，受其点化，获《万古药尊诀》残篇及数种奇药本源。仙鹤草固元，白鲜皮解毒，仙茅破障……方有今日。”他将系统之事模糊处理为“残存意识”和“残篇”，这是目前最能让人接受的解释。
“万古药尊诀？奇药本源？”林苍穹瞳孔微缩，一步步走近林药尘，强大的感知力如同无形的触手，试图探查其体内情况。然而，林药尘体内药力自成循环，更有系统隐隐护持，林苍穹的探查如同泥牛入海，不得其详，只能隐约感受到那股精纯而独特的药力波动。
“仙鹤草、白鲜皮、仙茅……”林苍穹低声重复着这几个名字，眼中闪过一丝追忆，“古籍有载，此皆为上古奇药，尤其仙茅，性热燥，有破僵通络、激发潜能之效，但药性猛烈，常人难驭，稍有不慎便会焚经灼脉……你竟能以此筑基修行？”
“弟子也是摸索前行，幸得那残存意识指引，方勉力驾驭。”林药尘不卑不亢。
林苍穹盯着他看了许久，忽然叹了口气，身上的威压收敛了几分：“罢了。机缘造化，各有天命。你能活下来，并恢复天赋，甚至更强，于林家而言，未必是坏事。”
content_en:
The dead silence over the martial arts field lasted for three full breaths.
It was an almost solidified sense of absurdity - Lin Xiaotian, who was arrogant a second ago and had the hope of the whole family, was now paralyzed in the dust ten feet away from the stage like a dead dog, his chest collapsed, blood stained the gorgeous brocade, and he didn't know whether he was alive or dead. And Lin Yaochen, who was once regarded by everyone as a "good-for-nothing" who had even been deprived of his qualifications to practice, stood like a silent bluestone in the center of the ring. Although the aura around him was not majestic, it carried a coldness that cut off cause and effect.
"Xiao Tian!!!"
A heart-rending roar finally broke the dead silence. On the high platform, the second elder Lin Potian's eyes were red, like an enraged ferocious beast. The aura around his body was raging crazily. The pressure of the ninth level of medicine disciple was released without reservation, causing the ground of the entire martial arts arena to tremble slightly. With a flash of his body, he was about to rush off the high platform.
"Second brother, stop!"
The voice of the Great Elder Lin Cangqiong was not high, but it contained an unquestionable majesty, like a bell ringing in Lin Potian's ears. A skinny but terrifying hand pressed down on Lin Potian's shoulder out of thin air, locking him in place.
"Brother, you..." Lin Potian turned around suddenly, his eyes full of resentment and unwillingness, but when he touched Lin Cangqiong's eyes as deep as ancient wells, he couldn't help but feel a chill in his heart.
Lin Cangqiong's face was as gloomy as water. His eyes first glanced at Lin Xiaotian, who was seriously injured and unconscious, his brows furrowed, and then fell on Lin Yaochen. His eyes were extremely complicated - suspicion, scrutiny, a trace of imperceptible fear, and a trace of... looseness that even he himself had not noticed.
"The rules of the competition are as follows. Life or death depends on one's destiny. Do you want to violate the ancestral precepts and attack a junior in front of the entire clan?" Lin Cangqiong's voice was cold and struck the hearts of every clan member.
Lin Potian's chest heaved violently, and his teeth chattered. But in the end, in the face of Lin Cangqiong's absolute suppression and family rules, he forcibly suppressed his overwhelming anger, but that look in his eyes almost ate Lin Yaochen alive in the audience. "Okay... let's stop at this point! Lin Yaochen, you have ruined my son's cultivation. This hatred is irreconcilable!"
In the audience, the Lin family members finally recovered from the huge shock, and buzzing discussions exploded like a tide.
"Oh my god... one punch! It was really just one punch! Lin Yaochen knocked Lin Xiaotian away!"
"How is this possible? Isn't he a body with a broken pulse? How can he have the power of the seventh level of a medicine disciple?"
"Look at the power of his punch just now, the red gold light, it is extremely domineering, it is definitely not the way of "Tiger Fist"!"
"Could it be that... he has really recovered? Or even... stronger?"
"Stronger? Huh, it's just a sneak attack using strange means! Young Master Xiaotian underestimated the enemy first..."
"Sneak attack? Are you blind? Lin Xiaotian's attack was so fierce just now, but Lin Yaochen avoided it with his body skills! That punch was a frontal blow, how powerful it was, and the guy's eyes are not blind!"
Shock, doubt, fear, schadenfreude...all kinds of emotions were intertwined among the crowd. The disciples from the side line who once avoided Lin Yaochen now looked at him with awe and strangeness in their eyes; while the close followers of Lin Potian's line all looked ashen, as if they were mourning for their heirs.
On the high platform, several elders looked at each other with a solemn atmosphere. The third elder stroked his beard and said in a low voice: "Brother, this kid Yaochen... is hidden deep enough. With his Jue meridians restored, he can break through to the seventh level of medicine disciple. The power of the punch just now is probably no less than that of the ordinary eighth level medicine disciple. Moreover, the aura contained in his punch is quite strange."
The fourth elder also echoed in a deep voice: "It is indeed strange. It is not pure martial arts, but it is like an explosion of some... highly concentrated medicinal power? Is he related to the rumored 'medicine cultivator'?" When the word "medicine cultivator" was mentioned, the eyes of several elders became dark. In this place where spiritual energy is exhaustedIn the world of Bahuang, orthodox martial arts have withered away, and the path of "medicine cultivation", which can use herbs to refine the body and borrow the power of medicine, has been almost lost and only exists in ancient legends.
Lin Cangqiong slowly took back his hand on Lin Potian's shoulder, his eyes never leaving Lin Yaochen. Naturally, he also felt the special fluctuations contained in that punch that were different from ordinary martial arts energy. As the eldest elder of the Lin family, he had extraordinary experience. He vaguely guessed that Lin Yaochen's transformation might be due to some kind of inheritance or opportunity that they didn't understand.
"Can I keep this son, or must I keep it in the hands of the family?" A thought whirled rapidly in Lin Cangqiong's mind. The Lin family seems to be strong now, but in fact there are internal and external troubles. There is harassment from the Black Wind Village in the north, and there are secret conflicts with the Wang family in the south. There are also many conflicts within the various houses. Is it a blessing or a curse for a "waste" with weird resilience to rise again?
At this time, Lin Yaochen slowly retracted his fist, feeling the curculigo medicinal power still boiling in his body, as well as the slight swelling and pain caused by the breakthrough in his meridians. He raised his head and faced Lin Cangqiong's scrutinizing gaze on the high platform. His eyes were calm, without the pride of a winner or the fear of Lin Potian, only a kind of indifference and tenacity after going through hardships.
He bowed and said in a clear and steady voice: "Great Elder, my disciple Lin Yaochen has won. According to the clan rules, he should be the first in the competition."
Lin Cangqiong was silent for a moment, and then he spoke. There was no emotion or anger in his voice: "Yes. The first place in the competition is indeed yours." He paused, glanced at the whole audience, and the pressure came, "The result of today's competition is determined. Xiaotian's injury is not serious. Second brother, you take him down for treatment immediately. The rest of the people, disperse!"
"Brother!" Lin Potian growled unwillingly.
"Huh?" Lin Cangqiong snorted coldly, raised his eyelids, and a stronger coercion came over him, "The clan rules are above, how do you treat me?"
Lin Potian's body stiffened, and he finally squeezed out a few words through his teeth: "...As ordered." He gave Lin Yaochen a look of resentment, picked up the unconscious Lin Xiaotian, and walked away quickly with a dark face surrounded by his cronies.
As the crowd gradually dispersed, only the mess on the ground and the elders with different expressions on the high platform were left. Lin Cangqiong took a deep look at Lin Yaochen and said, "Yaochen, come with me to the ancestral hall. The rest of you will take charge of your own affairs."
After saying that, he walked away. Lin Yaochen's expression remained unchanged and he followed silently. He knows that the real test begins now. An undercurrent concerning his future destiny, and even the internal power structure of the Lin family, is about to officially begin in the solemn ancestral hall.
…
The Lin Family Ancestral Hall, located in the hinterland of the family, is simple and profound, enshrining the tablets of ancestors from past dynasties. The air smelled of old wood and a hint of sandalwood.
Lin Cangqiong stood in front of the ancestral tablet with his hands behind his back. His back looked a little stooped, but he had an aura of great determination. After a long time, he spoke slowly, and his voice echoed in the empty ancestral hall: "Is the poison in your body healed? Is the critical pulse cleared?"
Lin Yaochen lowered his head: "Returning to the great elder, I was lucky enough to have a chance encounter. The poison has been cured and most of the meridians have been repaired."
"An adventure?" Lin Cangqiong turned around, his eyes as sharp as a knife, as if he wanted to reveal all the secrets of Lin Yaochen, "What kind of adventure can dissolve the 'Rotten Bone Powder' and penetrate the innate terminal veins? And it can also allow you to cultivate to the seventh level of Medicine Disciple in a short period of time, and perform such weird boxing techniques?"
Lin Yaochen had been prepared in his heart and said in a deep voice: "Disciple dare not hide it. When he was about to die, his soul was in a trance, as if he had fallen into a chaotic medicinal garden. He encountered a ray of remaining consciousness, received its enlightenment, and obtained the fragment of "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" And the origin of several kinds of strange medicines. The agrimony strengthens the essence, the white fresh skin detoxifies, and the curculigo breaks down the obstacles..." He vaguely treated the matter of the system as "remaining consciousness" and "fragmentary", which is the most acceptable explanation at present.
"The Secret of the Eternal Medicine Master? The origin of the wonder medicine?" Lin Cangqiong's pupils narrowed and he approached Lin Yaochen step by step., the powerful perception is like invisible tentacles, trying to detect the situation inside his body. However, the medicinal power in Lin Yaochen's body formed a cycle of its own, and was protected by a system. Lin Cangqiong's exploration was like a mud cow entering the sea, and he could only vaguely feel the pure and unique medicinal power fluctuations.
"Agrimony, white fresh bark, curculigo..." Lin Cangqiong repeated these names in a low voice, with a flash of reminiscence in his eyes. "It is recorded in ancient books that these are all ancient medicines, especially curculigo. It is hot and dry in nature. It has the effect of breaking stiffness and unblocking meridians and stimulating potential. However, the medicinal properties are strong and difficult for ordinary people to control. If you are not careful, it will burn the meridians and scorch the veins... How can you build the foundation for practice with this?"
"This disciple is also groping forward, but thanks to the guidance of his remaining consciousness, he manages to control it." Lin Yaochen is neither humble nor arrogant.
Lin Cangqiong stared at him for a long time, then suddenly sighed, and the pressure on his body subsided a little: "That's all. Chances are good, and everyone has their destiny. If you can survive and regain your talent, or even become stronger, it may not be a bad thing for the Lin family."
